links.why: The temporal clause 'while ... sang together' holds the infinitive 'sang together' nested in its role. The builder lists this link twice; it is kept once.
The second predicate 'and they shouted' lies inside the same temporal clause span.
The wayyiqtol 'they shouted' follows the infinitive, so the form gives 'and then'. The sense is simultaneous; see none_fit.

none_fit.what: Simultaneity (the stars sang while the sons shouted): no link type says 'at the same time'. The form gives 'and then'.
A time setting for the acts of 38:4 to 38:6 (when the foundations were laid): no cross-verse temporal link type.

cant_tell.what: The implied subject 'they' of cl2 ('they shouted', third masculine plural) has no slot.
cant_tell.why: The text makes it 'all the sons of God' (w7 to w9), which has no composite candidate, so no choice can be recorded for it.
